description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of different Audio-Language models on the MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR benchmarks. The horizontal axis displays the categorical variables, representing three models ordered from left to right: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, where each model category contains two adjacent bars distinguished by color according to the legend: a blue bar on the left representing MMAU and a purple bar on the right representing MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 48% and the MMAR bar is at roughly 30%, which is the shortest bar in the chart. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar is near 62% and the MMAR bar is approximately 37%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar is the tallest in the chart at approximately 67%, while its MMAR bar is near 58%. The categories do not follow an alphabetical sorting order, and there are no visually emphasized bars, outlines, or annotations present in the chart.
